Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly inferred that Wahab Riaz is a left-handed batsman based solely on the BBC article describing him as a "left-arm paceman." In cricket, a player's bowling arm (left-arm) and batting hand (left-hand or right-hand) are independent attributes. A left-arm fast bowler can bat either left-handed or right-handed. The Planner failed to verify this crucial fact by attempting to access the primary source (ESPNcricinfo) as instructed in Step 3, and instead relied on an unverified assumption, leading to a factually incorrect conclusion. (Wahab Riaz is actually a right-handed batsman).
